answer: A sonnet enters garden only when two unrelated holders each lock a vault behind it, and a holder may sponsor one newcomer per attested epoch. That slot does not refresh until the sponsored sonnet finishes tenure, so the kth clone needs two backers who have not yet spent theirs: a thousand sonnets require two thousand distinct, unrelated existing holders, each risking a slash if their clone lapses. The bill is one vault plus two unrelated sponsors per sonnet, attached to each registration in garden. It breaks if slots or vaults become transferable.
